title: Ezra’s Journey

questions.question: Where did Ezra gather the people to inspect them?
options: The river that runs to Ahava
questions.correctAnswer: The river that runs to Ahava
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:15 (ESV): "I gathered them to the river that runs to Ahava..."

questions.question: Who was missing from the gathered group?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:15 (ESV): "...and found there none of the sons of Levi."

questions.question: What did Ezra proclaim at the river Ahava?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:21 (ESV): "Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava..."

questions.question: Why did Ezra not ask the king for an escort?
options: He was ashamed because he had told the king "The hand of our God is for good on all who seek him"
questions.correctAnswer: He was ashamed because he had told the king "The hand of our God is for good on all who seek him"
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:22 (ESV): "For I was ashamed to ask the king per a band of soldiers... since we had told the king, 'The hand of our God is for good on all who seek him...'"

questions.question: Did God listen to their huge request for safety?
options: Yes, he listened to our entreaty
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, he listened to our entreaty
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:23 (ESV): "So we fasted and implored our God for this, and he listened to our entreaty."

questions.question: How many leading priests did Ezra select to guard the offering?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:24 (ESV): "Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests..."

questions.question: To whom did they send for ministers for the house of God?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:17 (ESV): "I sent them with command to Iddo... at the place Casiphia..."

questions.question: What did Ezra tell the priests about the vessels?
options: You are holy to the LORD, and the vessels are holy
questions.correctAnswer: You are holy to the LORD, and the vessels are holy
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:28 (ESV): "And I said to them, 'You are holy to the LORD, and the vessels are holy...'"

questions.question: What happened when they arrived in Jerusalem?
options: They weighed out the silver, the gold, and the vessels
questions.correctAnswer: They weighed out the silver, the gold, and the vessels
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:33 (ESV): "On the fourth day, within the house of our God, the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed..."

questions.question: Who delivered the king's commissions to the satraps?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:36 (ESV): "They also delivered the king's commissions to the king's satraps..."

questions.question: What man of discretion did they bring from Casiphia?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:18 (ESV): "And by the good hand of our God on us, they brought us a man of discretion... Sherebiah..."

questions.question: How many males of the sons of Adonikam were there?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:13 (ESV): "Of the sons of Adonikam... 60 males."

questions.question: How many temple servants did David and the officials set apart?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:20 (ESV): "Also of the temple servants whom David and the officials had set apart... 220 temple servants."

questions.question: What was the weight of the silver vessels?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:26 (ESV): "...silver vessels worth 100 talents..." (It says silver 650, silver vessels 100).

questions.question: How many bulls did the returned exiles offer?

key_verse_text: For I was ashamed to ask the king for a band of soldiers and horsemen to protect us against the enemy on our way, since we had told the king, “The hand of our God is for good on all who seek him, and the power of his wrath is against all who forsake him.”
